messages:
sam: Heads-up: saw a customer hit a weird failure when they send mixed-dim embeddings in one batch to /v1/embeddings. Server returned 200 but element order shuffled? Anyone else seen this? Example payload below.

lee: Can you paste the payload + logs? We should either reject mixed dims with 4xx or auto-pad/convert. Current impl expects uniform dims per batch.

sam: ```
POST /v1/embeddings
{
  "model": "text-embed-001",
  "input": [
    {"id": "a", "vector": [0.12, 0.3, ... /* 1536 floats */]},
    {"id": "b", "vector": [0.01, 0.02, ... /* 768 floats */]}
  ]
}
```

maria: Oof. This is known — we coerce smaller vectors into float16 then append zeros on the backend to align, but that path wasn't tested for reorder. It should not shuffle though. That's a bug.

ashley: Telemetry: we have metrics for embedding_batch_size and embedding_dim_variance but no counter for 'mixed-dim-batches'. Can we add an alert? Also console UX: we should surface a warning on routes that accept embeddings arrays.

jorge: Routing policies: if a request comes via dedicated vs hosted, behavior differs — dedicated nodes run old runtime that pads, hosted returns 400. We need consistent semantics. Proposal: host returns 400 for mixed dims and SDKs show actionable error with suggested fix.

lee: Agree on consistent 4xx. Simpler and safer. We can add a feature flag to enable legacy padding for customers who opt-in (Dedicated/Private).

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Created issue #2345 — 'embeddings: reject mixed-dim batches on hosted; add opt-in padding for dedicated'. Blocking PR: https://redwood.internal/pull/2345

ashley: Small UX ask: console should show per-route 'accepted embedding dims' and a hero callout when route sees >1 dim. I can mock this in Figma.

sam: I'll open a quick PR to change hosted behavior to 400 and add a structured error: code EMB_DIM_MISMATCH, message, hint. Will include telemetry tag 'mixed_dim=true'. Example error:

```
HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
{
  "error": {
    "code": "EMB_DIM_MISMATCH",
    "message": "All vectors in a batch must have the same dimension. Received dims: [1536,768]",
    "hint": "Split into separate requests or use a dedicated route with legacy padding enabled."
  }
}
```

maria: Test plan: unit test for reorder bug, e2e with float16 padding path, add telemetry counter and alert when rate > 1% of batches. Also update docs.

lee: :thumbsup: let's aim for a canary deploy next week. I'll coordinate with eng-infra.
